bridge-type.label: AutoBlind Hub
bridge-type.description: Norman ShadeAuto hub connected via local network

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: IP address or hostname of the ShadeAuto hub

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds between status polls

thing-type.label: AutoBlind Shade
thing-type.description: A motorized shade controlled by the ShadeAuto hub

parameter.name: peripheralUid
parameter.label: Peripheral UID
parameter.description: Unique identifier of the shade on the hub

parameter.name: invertPosition
parameter.label: Invert Position
parameter.description: Invert reported and commanded shade position so 0% means open and 100% means closed in openHAB (required for hubs that report the opposite, like Norman ShadeAuto). Disable if your hub already reports position using the same convention as openHAB.

channel-type.label: Position
channel-type.description: Shade position (0% = fully open, 100% = fully closed)
